name: kaizenkids
description: KaizenKids — Atomik Alışkanlıklar felsefesiyle çocuklar için Telegram Mini App (MVP)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @kaizenkids/server" "npm run dev -w @kaizenkids/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kaizenkids/web && npm run build -w @kaizenkids/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @kaizenkids/server && npm run typecheck -w @kaizenkids/web
